chunks: And Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā narrated from ʿUmar ibn Ḥanẓalah, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: "May I marry a woman for a month with a specified dowry, and she comes for part of the month but does not fulfill the rest of the month?"
He عليه السلام said: "You withhold from her dowry in proportion to what she withheld herself from you, except the days of her menstruation, for they are hers."

key_terms.احْتَبَسَتْ: she withheld herself or was unavailable
key_terms.بِقَدْرِ: in proportion to or according to the measure of
key_terms.شَهْرًا: a month as the specified term of the marriage
key_terms.صَدَاقِهَا: her dowry owed in the marriage contract

ai.seo_question: In temporary marriage, can part of the dowry be withheld if the woman does not fulfill the agreed period?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning temporary marriage when the woman does not make herself available for part of the agreed term. The dowry may be reduced proportionally for the period she withheld herself, except for the days of menstruation, which are exempt and remain her right.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4596 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Umar ibn Hanzalah who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (as): "Can I marry a woman for a month with a specified dowry, but she only fulfills part of the month and does not fulfill the rest?"
Imam (as) said: "You withhold from her dowry an amount proportional to the time she withheld herself from you, except for the days of her menstruation, as those days belong to her."
